title: 第十一章 对不起我迟到了第十二章 这是什么东西啊
content_zh:
这身材，简直好到爆炸。
超短白包腿裙，完全贴合完美的臀部曲线，修长的小腿笔直而平滑，大腿丰腴光滑，尤其是细细的腰身配上丰满的翘臀，很有视觉冲击力。
当女人在电梯里转过来的时候，陆原看到了她的样子，正点，同样很正。
超漂亮的一个正妹，挺成熟的，有二十五六岁，比陆原大一点，但是这个年龄正好，没有了少女那种柔气，更多了一种女人该有的韵味。
啧啧，还是社会上的女人有味道啊。
就在电梯门快要合上的时候，陆原急忙跻身进去。
女人有点不悦的看了陆原一眼，似乎责怪陆原耽误她时间一样。
不过倒是也没说什么。
电梯里，就女人和陆原。
从女人身上发出的香味充斥在电梯里，这种芬芳，让陆原忍不住有点心猿意马。
女人站在前面，陆原站在女人的侧后面，这角度很好，可以欣赏女人的完美身材。
虽然陆原在心里不停的说要君子要君子不要看不要看。
但是，面对这样的女人，谁还能君子的住啊。
突然，女人回头看了看陆原，惊道：“你干嘛！”
“没干嘛啊。”陆原立刻恢复了一副正人君子的模样。
“没干嘛？你难道不是在偷看我？”女人冷笑一声，这个吊丝，还不承认？
真是够傻的，这个电梯里很光滑，四壁和镜子一样，女人完全可以从镜子里看到身后陆原的一举一动。
“我，我没有偷看啊。”
陆原心虚了，尤其是这女人看起来泼辣而又大气，年龄也比自己大，语气凌厉，让陆原竟然有点害怕她。
正说着，陆原突然感觉到鼻子一阵热辣辣的，接着，好像有东西从鼻子里流了出来。

“呵呵，还说没有？”
女子指着陆原，“你都流鼻血了，小弟弟。”
啊？
陆原急忙一抹鼻子，真的流鼻血了，我草，太丢人了吧。
其实这也不怪陆原，因为这女人身材真是太好了，而且现在女人转过来的时候，正面对着陆原，电梯狭窄，陆原可以更清楚的看清楚女人胸口白皙的皮肤，不得不说，女人实在很漂亮，很难不让人心动。
难怪，陆原会突然有反应。
陆原手一抹，就觉得鼻腔里痒痒的，阿嚏！
陆原狠狠的打了一个喷嚏。
女人却发出一声惊呼。
原来陆原的鼻血直接喷到了女人的胸口，不偏不倚，正好喷在了女人胸口。
“对不起。”
陆原心里暗叫一声真丢人，想掏纸巾却发现自己没有，他来不及多想，竟然神出鬼差的伸出手，去帮女人擦拭。
“你干嘛？”女人的脸色更难看了。
“我帮你擦血啊。”陆原下意识说道，说完，他也愣住了。
content_en:
This figure is so damn good.
The ultra-short white leg-wrapped skirt perfectly fits the perfect hip curve. The slender calves are straight and smooth, and the thighs are plump and smooth. Especially the thin waist and plump buttocks are very visually impactful.
When the woman turned around in the elevator, Lu Yuan saw her appearance. She was on point, equally upright.
A super beautiful girl, quite mature, in her mid-twenties, a little older than Lu Yuan, but at the right age, without the softness of a girl, more of a charm that a woman should have.
Gee, women in society still have taste.
Just when the elevator door was about to close, Lu Yuan hurriedly stepped in.
The woman glanced at Lu Yuan a little displeasedly, as if blaming Lu Yuan for wasting her time.
But he didn’t say anything.
In the elevator, it was just the woman and Lu Yuan.
The fragrance from the woman filled the elevator. This fragrance made Lu Yuan unable to help but feel a little distracted.
The woman stood in front, and Lu Yuan stood behind the woman. This was a good angle from which he could appreciate the woman's perfect figure.
Although Lu Yuan kept saying in his heart that he should be a gentleman, he should not look at it.
However, in the face of such a woman, who can live like a gentleman?
Suddenly, the woman looked back at Lu Yuan and said in shock: "What are you doing!"
"Nothing." Lu Yuan immediately regained his appearance as a gentleman.
"What are you doing? Aren't you peeking at me?" The woman sneered. Why don't you admit this?
It's really silly. The elevator is very smooth, and the walls are like mirrors. The woman can see Lu Yuan's every move behind her in the mirror.
"I, I didn't peek."
Lu Yuan felt guilty, especially since this woman looked fierce and powerful, she was older than him, and her tone was sharp, which made Lu Yuan a little afraid of her.
Just as he was talking, Lu Yuan suddenly felt a burning sensation in his nose, and then something seemed to flow out of his nose.
"Haha, you still said no?"
The woman pointed at Lu Yuan, "You have a nosebleed, little brother."
Huh?
Lu Yuan hurriedly wiped his nose. He really had a nosebleed. Damn it, it was so embarrassing.
In fact, it's not Lu Yuan's fault, because this woman's figure is really good, and when the woman turns around, she is facing Lu Yuan. The elevator is narrow, and Lu Yuan can see the fair skin on the woman's chest more clearly. It has to be said that the woman is really beautiful, and it is difficult not to make people's hearts flutter.
No wonder Lu Yuan reacted suddenly.
As soon as Lu Yuan wiped his hand, he felt itchy in his nose, sneeze!
Lu Yuan sneezed hard.
The woman let out a cry of surprise.
It turned out that Lu Yuan's nosebleed sprayed directly onto the woman's chest, and it hit the woman's chest without any bias.
"I'm sorry."
Lu Yuan secretly screamed, "How embarrassing." He wanted to take out a tissue but found that he didn't have any. Before he could think about it, he unexpectedly stretched out his hand to help the woman wipe it.
"What are you doing?" The woman's face turned even more ugly.
"Let me wipe the blood for you." Lu Yuan said subconsciously. After saying that, he was stunned.
